jobs.description:
What to Expect

We are seeking a proactive and customer-focused Inbound Sales Specialist to handle sales calls that cannot be answered by retail stores during peak hours. This role is critical to ensure no customer inquiry is missed, maintaining high service levels, and driving sales conversion. The specialist will manage inbound calls with professionalism, accuracy, and speed, ensuring every conversation is logged correctly in our system.

- Be a key part of the customer journey — no call goes unanswered
- Work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with clear impact
- Support store teams and contribute directly to sales performance
- Opportunity for growth within the sales and operations team

What You’ll Do

- Answer incoming sales calls, messages and emails that are not picked up by retail stores during operating hours (8:00 AM – 7:00 PM)
- Log in to the company CRM/system promptly at the start of the shift and ensure availability
- Document each call in the system with full details: customer name, contact info, vehicle interest, key conversation points, objections, and next steps
- Maintain 100% call logging accuracy to support sales tracking and follow-up
- Work efficiently under pressure to ensure fast response times and minimal wait for customers
- Collaborate with store teams and Inside Sales to ensure seamless handover and consistent customer experience

What You’ll Bring

- Proven experience in customer service or sales support (call center or retail preferred)
- Strong communication and active listening skills in German (and English if applicable)
- Ability to work independently and manage time effectively
- Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace (if remote)
- Willingness to work flexible shifts, 3 shifts available: 8:00 am-5:00 pm, 9:00 am-6:00pm, 10:00 am-7:00 pm  
- Advanced German language skills are needed

jobs.occupation: Operations Coordinator, Vehicle Engineering (m/w/d) Berlin (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

Tesla's Vehicle and Powertrain Engineering teams in Berlin are looking for an Engineering Operations Coordinator to serve as the operational backbone of the organization. You will work closely with engineering managers, HR, and factory stakeholders to support our engineers in building the world's best vehicles.The Vehicle and Powertrain Design Engineering teams in Europe are developing and launching new vehicle programs and technology for Tesla’s global products and working closely with Gigafactory Berlin and the local and global test engineering teams.This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, works highly organized, takes ownership without being asked, and brings structure to ambiguity.

What You’ll Do

- Own the day-to-day workplace experience for the Vehicle Engineering team — from managing seating and workwear budgets to organizing team events and acting as the main liaison with facilities. Track and act on Pulse Survey feedback, coordinate anniversary recognition, and ensure the team has a well-organized, engaging place to work.
- Coordinate recruiting efforts for vehicle engineering by collaborating closely with recruiting and Design Engineering hiring managers specifically for graduate and early talent programs but not limited to it
- Serve as the operational bridge between Design Engineering and Gigafactory Berlin — managing non-technical workflows, service agreements, and team administration. Coordinate executive visits, own the non-technical agenda for weekly team meetings, and keep day-to-day operations running smoothly across travel, PTO, and site housekeeping.
- Manage the engineering fleet for Vehicle Engineering, including vehicle allocation, scheduling, and coordination with relevant stakeholders
- Perform additional responsibilities in alignment with Design Engineering management in daily operations assigned to meet business needs.

What You’ll Bring

- 1-3 year of experience (more is acceptable) in operations, program coordination, project management, or a related field — ideally within an engineering, automotive, or technology environment
- Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously without losing attention to detail
- Strong communication skills — able to interface confidently with engineers, managers, factory teams, and senior leadership
- Fluency in English required; German is a strong advantage given the Berlin factory context
- Ability to thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment, effectively multitask, prioritize tasks and processes, and track findings and deliverables
- Proactive, self-directed work style — you identify what needs to be done and do it
- Driven and enthusiastic with a genuine interest and passion for Tesla's mission
- Have and continue to maintain a driver's license valid in Germany and safe driving record

jobs.occupation: Associate Installer Support Engineer (Spanish Speaking) - (m/w/d) - Fixed Term Contract (Techniker/in - Elektrotechnik (ohne Schwerpunkt)/Bachelor Professional in Technik)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

Please submit your CV in English in order to be considered for the role.This role is available in Manchester, Amsterdam, and Berlin.This is a 12-month fixed-term contract with the possibility of extension.The Installer Support team serves as an escalation point for our network of channel partners who distribute, install and service residential Tesla energy products. We strive to empower our channel partners to provide the best end-customer experience possible, and we are an endpoint for determining next steps and solutions for many situations.Installer Support Engineering Technicians offer real-time diagnostics and solutions for trained on-site technicians during installation and maintenance of Tesla’s residential solar, storage and home charging energy products. Strong candidates for this role will already have knowledge in the residential energy industry. Applicants should expect to become a subject matter expert (SME) with Tesla’s energy products with the ability to remotely access and troubleshoot equipment.This is an exciting, fast-paced and rewarding role, and a fantastic opportunity to dig deep into our innovative products while collaborating with some of the most talented people in the world!

What You’ll Do

- Provide top-tier support for live on-site or off-site technical issues regarding residential energy products via phone, chat, email or other channels
- Follow best practices in case handling, follow-up, and documenting interactions and work performed with great detail
- Become highly knowledgeable in the technical operation and complexities of Tesla’s energy products
- Understand and troubleshoot proprietary power electronics systems and their supporting components
- Read and understand single-line diagrams as they pertain to PV and storage systems as well as load and meter component placement
- Review operational logs in proprietary and non-proprietary applications
- Identify trending issues, collect information and report findings to leadership and engineering teams
- Identify process and knowledge gaps and submit feedback that leads to better training and resources
- Become a subject matter expert (SME) in residential Tesla energy products.
- Utilise software including Linux environments, SSH, and more for advanced troubleshooting

What You’ll Bring

- Bachelor's degree in a technical or engineering field, or a minimum of 2+ years’ experience in a technician role
- Fluency in English and Spanish is required for this role 
- Ability to independently make decisions and solve problems with limited direction
- Outstanding written and verbal interpersonal communication skills
- Experience and understanding of customer service, technical support and engineering environments
- Ability to document interactions and steps clearly, accurately and with detail
- Ability to prioritize workflows effectively according to multiple criteria
- Understanding of electrical theory and experience with emphasis on AC/DC power systems or other electronic systems, devices and components
- Experience troubleshooting metering and communications issues involving many variables
- Understanding of commercial electrical metering, energy flow, power factor, and phase rotation
- Electrical engineering knowledge and/or experience is a plus

jobs.occupation: Inside Sales Executive (f/m/d) (Kaufmann/-frau - Spedition und Logistikdienstleistung)
jobs.description:
Welcome to Rhenus!

The Rhenus Group is one of the leading global logistics service providers. Across the entire supply chain, we offer tailored solutions for companies from a wide range of industries. From multimodal transportation and optimal warehousing to seamless customs clearance and innovative value-added services, we stay at the forefront of industry developments and work closely alongside our customers every step of the way.

What you can expect

- In your role, you will proactively contact potential customers by phone and email, qualify leads using CRM systems, and manage opportunities through to handover or direct quotation.
- You will prepare and follow up on tailored offers, including follow-up calls, while working closely with the field sales, tender management, and pricing team to develop suitable logistics solutions.
- You will maintain accurate customer data in the CRM and support the planning and implementation of sales campaigns, mailings, and trade fair participation.
- You will participate in internal sales meetings to align on customer targeting and strategies, while continuously monitoring the market and competitors for new business opportunities.
- Additionally, you will qualify inbound leads from marketing activities and prepare basic pricing calculations to support a smooth and efficient sales process.

What you bring

- You have successfully completed a commercial training, ideally in the field of freight forwarding or logistics services.
- First experience in inside sales or operational air / sea freight is an advantage.
- Naturally, you enjoy speaking with customers and have strong communication skills, especially over the phone.
- A structured and goal-oriented mindset defines your way of working, and you are able to work independently.
- You are confident using MS Office and CRM systems. German fluency is essential, and English skills are beneficial.

Your benefits:

- Agile Environment: Embrace a dynamic work culture, where you and your team adapt quickly to meet evolving needs.
- Events: From team outings to holiday parties and networking events, we build strong connections by spending quality time together.
- Exclusive Discounts: Enjoy exclusive perks: Our extensive partner network gives you access to special discounts with various providers.
- Flat Hierarchies: Get straight through to the decision-makers with our streamlined organizational structure.
- Monthly Gift Vouchers: Enjoy an extra amount each month for fuel, groceries, or entertainment.
- Personalized Growth: Accelerate your career with development opportunities, tailored to your talents and interests.

jobs.occupation: VPP Operations Specialist – Germany (m/w/d) (Bau- und Projektkaufmann/-frau)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

We are scaling our Virtual Power Plant (VPP) operations into the German energy market and are looking for a hands-on VPP Operations Specialist – Germany to support that growth from day one. We need someone who can roll up their sleeves, own exceptions end-to-end, and bring deep practical knowledge of how the German energy market operates at a process and regulatory level.You will be embedded in our Operations team, working closely with our flexibility, settlements, and support functions across the globe. A key part of your role will be upskilling our support staff on German market workflows, participant journeys, and exception handling – ensuring the whole team can operate confidently as we grow our German footprint.

What You’ll Do

Market Operations

- Apply working knowledge of the German energy regulatory landscape (BNetzA, BDEW) to day-to-day operational tasks.
- Manage and resolve data flow exceptions relating to MaKo/EDIFACT messaging, GPKE, and WiM processes, and MSB/VNB interactions.
- Support the accurate management of MaLo and MeLo data, ensuring data integrity across systems.
- Work within the MsbG metering framework and support smart meter rollout processes relevant to VPP-connected assets.
- Demonstrate solid understanding of MaBis processes.
- Monitor Bilanzkreis and settlement obligations relevant to our flexible asset portfolio in Germany.Flexibility Participant & Exception Management
- Act as the primary handler for escalated exceptions arising from the German flexibility participant journey – from asset registration through to settlement and payment queries.
- Own complex cases end-to-end, coordinating across internal teams (settlements, tech, finance) to reach resolution.
- Identify recurring issues and escalate systemic root causes with clear data and recommended fixes.
- Support onboarding of new German flexibility participants and asset owners, ensuring a smooth and compliant process.Training & Knowledge Transfer
- Design and deliver structured training sessions for UK-based support staff covering German market processes, regulatory obligations, and participant workflows.
- Build and maintain clear, practical playbooks, process guides, and FAQs for use by the wider support team.
- Conduct regular knowledge gap assessments and adjust training content accordingly.
- Review training effectiveness and iterate based on team performance and feedback.Process Improvement & Efficiency
- Actively identify manual or repetitive tasks and find ways to reduce effort through process redesign or tooling.
- Maintain up-to-date process documentation in a clear, accessible format.
- Flag regulatory or process changes in the German market that may impact operations and recommend responses.

What You’ll Bring

Candidates should be able to demonstrate practical working knowledge across most of the following:

- BNetzA regulatory framework and BDEW market rules
- MaKo communication standards and EDIFACT message types
- GPKE (supplier switching) and WiM (metering point management) processes
- MsbG obligations and the role of the Messstellenbetreiber (MSB)
- MaLo (market location) and MeLo (metering location) data structures
- Bilanzkreis management and balancing group settlement
- German electricity billing structures including Netzentgelte and Grundversorgung vs. competitive supply frameworks
- Direktvermarktung framework
- MaBis processes for balancing group settlement reconciliation
- FCR/aFRR/mFFR prequalification and flexibility market participation rules (desirable)Essential
- Fluent in English and German (written and spoken), with experience communicating with German counterparts and producing documentation in both languages
